post.description: Grants the same set of rewards (items, currencies, and drop tables) to multiple users in a single call. Drop tables are rolled independently for each user. Grants are best-effort and isolated per user: a failure for one user does not roll back or block the others, and each user's outcome is returned in the results. The top-level success is true only if every user was granted successfully. Up to 100 users per call.
